passage:
A school installed sensors to find leaks in water pipes. One sensor showed water moving at night when no one was using it.
Workers found a hidden leak under the gym. It had wasted water for weeks.
The science club used the case to explain conservation. Saving water was not only about shorter showers or closing taps. It also required maintaining systems.
Students made a poster: "Leaks are invisible bills."
The sensor helped because it listened when people were not present.
Modern conservation needs both personal habits and infrastructure care. A responsible community checks the pipes as well as the people.
